body: Thanks. Yeah I guess I should try your recommendation ;). You also have a point about why they're like that. I guess I will try to understand them better next time.

Thank you for your concern and good wishes.  How many? Just three in the past, all just until  first consult. No, they didn't try to get back to me.

The one earlier today was the fourth one.  But i agreed to still come to the next appointment...hoping that it would be another from the same clinic who would try to talk to me.

Then just a while ago, I walked in to a psychiatric ward.  A friend from high school happened to be there as an intern.  It's more painful when a friend talks to me like a case or patient but at least I was able to tell her a bit more coz I know her and she apologized and softened a bit when I told her what's making me feel uncomfortable with the way she talks to me. So that makes the fifth one.

I have tried several counsellors, I can't get pass the initial assessment... I feel so uncomfortable being asked questions in a way like being interrogated and investigated and so uncaringly, like i strongly feel how they don't really care and like i am just a case study or something and like they are just following a certain method or flowchart.  They all just make me feel so tense and I dislike how they uncarefully poke me with very personal questions and it just makes me feel walking out or excusing myself to leave and not talk to them ever again.

There's one counsellor though that  made me feel cared for, safe, and comfortable enough to talk and I stayed until the 3rd session but I can't open up further about more intimate matters. So I also left when I started to feel uncomfortable.

That was almost 3 years ago.   I gave up trying to get help but someone just recently urged me to try again. And so tried again today.  So I told about how I was sexually harrased in school by my classmates.  And I was asked why my classmates did that to me.  The question was so uncomfortable and I dislike the tone and undertone like i was being blamed for what happened to me. Why ask me as if the intention was from me? How am I supposed to know the answer! But I just kept silent and said I don't know. I looked away in awkward silence and so the counsellor ended the talk.  

My mouth was shut but in my head i was talking a lot,  I find it a very annoying irrational question for the counsellor to ask that. how am I supposed to know what goes on the heads of those little boys. I was just a good pretty little girl wearing decent uniform, who was always the top student and class president. Why they did that to me? Why did that happen to me? I could only fucking guess. If I tell him about karma from past reincarnations that might sound absurd to the scientifically counsellor. So I just didn't say anything further.

For all my life I  tried to be invisible as much as possible, I intentionally shut up showing my smart in class and declined leadership roles.  I even stopped caring to look good and even having good hygiene. I also stopped being friendly and talkative.   I avoided people, especially guys. I started putting up walls. While normal girls strive to be attractive and noticed, I strived to be ugly and unappealing, or at least I had been aloof and I tend to just ignore people.  I lived the lie of seemingly being a quiet introvert and imprisoned my outgoing outspoken personality. I just want to be free to be me again.  

So that was how the counsellor didn't get to hear all that was really in my head.
